basis: Explicit reviewed candidate list required by migration-baseline-reconciliation.json releaseStrategy and conclusions. Apply in listed order. Automatic database push remains prohibited against the staging ledger and against production.

Reviewed 2026-10-15 against main and the candidate branch.
candidates.notes: Highest-blast-radius candidate. Adds nullable retailer_account_id to portal_order and portal_receiving_claim plus two scope indexes.

candidates.name: provision_workforce_workspace_membership
candidates.rerunSafeBasis: CREATE OR REPLACE function, trigger recreated, inserts use ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; the repair call is idempotent.
candidates.notes: requestWorkspace requires an active portal_organization_membership row. The prior Auth trigger created a profile without that membership, so this must be applied before the handlers deploy or affected workforce identities receive 403. The migration calls portal_repair_workforce_workspace_memberships() itself and fails closed when the active Internal organization is absent.

candidates.name: store_financial_hold_and_license_lifecycle
candidates.rerunSafeBasis: CREATE TABLE/INDEX IF NOT EXISTS, CREATE OR REPLACE functions, DROP ... IF EXISTS before every trigger, constraint and retired signature, ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING seeds, and a guarded one-time rename of portal_store_command; supabase/tests/store_account_controls_database_test.mjs applies it twice in a disposable container.
candidates.blockingDecision: Every portal_order insert pauses (UXL01) at a location without an audited verification of its current expiration, including locations activated before this migration and staff-entered orders. A verification backfill or plan must be approved before apply.
candidates.notes: Approved 2026-10-15 Store account policy: manual-hold-only financial block, inherited account payment terms, document-UUID license verification, atomic state-bound onboarding completion, license order boundary, store_billing role, T-30 reminder intents with delivery locked off, audited license-document access. Local checkpoint 2026-10-15 (same version, re-reviewed checksum): Internal Compliance recipient seeded as confirmed and reaffirmed rather than pending review; account recipient is the active Account Owner else the designated main contact (legacy portal_retailer_account.account_owner_email); a due license with neither records one append-only, deduplicated portal_license_reminder_exception and no guessed recipient; portal_manage_store_membership is replaced to admit store_billing with zero location assignments. Replaces portal_resolve_store_context and portal_manage_store_membership, and renames portal_store_command to portal_store_command_core behind a wrapper. Store access remains disabled. Live Storage and Auth integration is untested.

ordering: Apply candidates 1 through 5 in listed order before deploying any handler that imports _shared/request-workspace.ts.
Candidate 5 must precede handler deployment so existing workforce identities retain an active Internal membership.

Candidates 2 and 3 must both be applied before any handler deployment; storeCommand and resolveStoreContext fail closed (503/403) when their functions are absent, which degrades Store paths rather than opening them.
Internal and Brand request paths return before resolveStoreContext is reached, so they are unaffected by candidate 2 and 3 timing.

Candidate 6 follows candidates 2, 3 and 4 (it replaces portal_resolve_store_context and portal_manage_store_membership, and wraps portal_store_command) and deploys only together with its gated handlers, after its blocking decision is closed.
prohibited: supabase db push against production or the staging project
replaying historical repository migrations against the staging schema-only baseline
applying candidate 2, 3 or 4 twice without an explicit repair review
enabling Store access or releasing the Store ordering hold as part of applying this list
